Jak uzyskać Client ID: How to get a Client ID
Jednorazowo: identyfikatory aplikacji za: One-time setup: IDs of the application registered with the provider (Client ID).
Każdy dostawca wymaga jednorazowej rejes:
Each provider requires a one-time application registration (free):

MICROSOFT (OneDrive)
1. portal.azure.com → App registrations → New registration
2. Supported account types: any organizational directory + personal Microsoft accounts
3. Redirect URI: platform 'Public client/native', address http://localhost
4. Copy the 'Application (client) ID'

GOOGLE (Google Drive)
1. console.cloud.google.com → new project → enable 'Google Drive API'
2. OAuth consent screen: type External, add your e-mail as a test user
3. Credentials → Create OAuth client ID → type 'Desktop app'
4. Copy the Client ID and Client Secret

DROPBOX
1. dropbox.com/developers/apps → Create app → Scoped access → App folder
2. Permissions: files.content.write, files.content.read, account_info.read
3. Settings → Redirect URIs: {redirect_uri}
4. Copy the 'App key'
Klucz TOTP (2FA) - Base32 lub link otpau: TOTP key (2FA) - Base32 or otpauth:// link
